newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coles Myer board member Morgan resigns.
newsitem.headline: Coles Myer board member Morgan resigns.

text.p: Retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Wednesday executive director Peter Morgan has resigned from the board of directors after a review of the board's composition.

Stan Wallis, who took over as chairman on Wednesday following the retirement of Nobby Clark, said Morgan's resignation was to maintain an appropriate ratio of independent to non-independent directors.
Chief executive officer Dennis Eck now remains the only executive director on the board.
Wallis said Morgan, who spent eight years on the Coles Myer board, would continue as director of planning and corporate affairs.
Clark's retirement was announced in October 1996.
